concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a diverse team in a modern meeting room with natural light, warm colors, and a relaxed atmosphere. The team is seated around a wooden table, engaged in discussion. Use a wide-angle lens, with a slightly low camera angle to convey a sense of importance. Incorporate laptops, notebooks, and a large screen display in the background.
concepts.title: Diverse Business Team Meeting
concepts.description: A group of people from different ethnic backgrounds seated around a meeting table, engaged in a discussion. The room is filled with natural light and modern office equipment.

concepts.subject: Happy Family Outdoor Picnic
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a happy family having a picnic in a park on a sunny day. The family is sitting on a blanket, surrounded by trees and flowers. Use a soft, warm lighting style, and a composition that captures the joy and laughter of the moment. Incorporate a wicker basket, food, and drinks in the scene.
concepts.title: Family Enjoying Outdoor Picnic
concepts.description: A family of four, including two children, sitting on a blanket in a park, enjoying food and drinks during a sunny day.

concepts.subject: Fresh Fruit Salad Bowl
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a fresh fruit salad in a bowl, with a variety of colorful fruits, such as strawberries, blueberries, and pineapple. Use a bright and airy lighting style, and a composition that highlights the texture and freshness of the fruits. Incorporate a wooden spoon and a sprinkle of granola on top.
concepts.title: Fresh Fruit Salad in Bowl
concepts.description: A bowl filled with a mix of fresh fruits, including strawberries, blueberries, and pineapple, topped with granola and a wooden spoon on the side.

concepts.subject: Person Working on Laptop
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a person working on a laptop in a modern coffee shop. The person is sitting at a small table, with a cup of coffee and a notebook beside them. Use a warm and cozy lighting style, and a composition that captures the focus and concentration of the moment. Incorporate a blurred background to emphasize the person's work.
concepts.title: Person Working on Laptop in Coffee Shop
concepts.description: A person sitting at a small table in a coffee shop, working on a laptop with a cup of coffee and a notebook beside them.

concepts.subject: Serene Mountain Landscape
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a serene mountain landscape at sunrise, with a misty valley and a range of mountains in the background. Use a soft and peaceful lighting style, and a composition that captures the grandeur and majesty of the scene. Incorporate a few trees and a winding road in the foreground.
concepts.title: Serene Mountain Landscape at Sunrise
concepts.description: A mountain landscape at sunrise, with a misty valley and a range of mountains in the background, and a few trees and a winding road in the foreground.

concepts.subject: Diverse Group Friends Laughing
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a diverse group of friends laughing and having fun together in a park. The group is sitting on a blanket, surrounded by trees and flowers. Use a bright and vibrant lighting style, and a composition that captures the joy and camaraderie of the moment. Incorporate a variety of ethnicities, ages, and abilities in the group.
concepts.title: Diverse Group of Friends Laughing
concepts.description: A group of friends from different ethnic backgrounds, ages, and abilities, sitting on a blanket in a park, laughing and having fun together.

concepts.subject: Person Meditating in Nature
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a person meditating in a peaceful natural setting, such as a forest or a mountain meadow. The person is sitting on a rock or a blanket, with their eyes closed and a calm expression. Use a soft and serene lighting style, and a composition that captures the tranquility and inner peace of the moment. Incorporate a few trees, flowers, or other natural elements in the background.
concepts.title: Person Meditating in Peaceful Nature
concepts.description: A person sitting on a rock in a peaceful natural setting, meditating with their eyes closed and a calm expression, surrounded by trees and flowers.

concepts.subject: Person Working from Home Office
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a person working from a home office, with a desk, a chair, and a laptop. The room is filled with natural light, and there are a few plants and decorations in the background. Use a bright and airy lighting style, and a composition that captures the comfort and productivity of the moment. Incorporate a few books, papers, and office supplies on the desk.
concepts.title: Person Working from Home Office
concepts.description: A person sitting at a desk in a home office, working on a laptop with a few plants and decorations in the background, and a few books and office supplies on the desk.

concepts.subject: Modern Conference Room Meeting
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a modern conference room meeting, with a large wooden table and a few chairs. The room is filled with natural light, and there are a few plants and decorations in the background. Use a bright and professional lighting style, and a composition that captures the importance and productivity of the moment. Incorporate a few laptops, notebooks, and a large screen display on the wall.
concepts.title: Modern Conference Room Meeting
concepts.description: A group of people sitting around a large wooden table in a modern conference room, with a few laptops and notebooks, and a large screen display on the wall.

concepts.subject: Happy Couple on Beach Vacation
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a happy couple on a beach vacation, walking along the shore and holding hands. The sun is setting in the background, and there are a few palm trees and beach chairs in the distance. Use a warm and romantic lighting style, and a composition that captures the joy and love of the moment. Incorporate a few seagulls flying overhead and a gentle wave crashing in the foreground.
concepts.title: Happy Couple on Beach Vacation
concepts.description: A happy couple walking along the shore, holding hands, and enjoying a romantic beach vacation at sunset, with a few palm trees and beach chairs in the distance.
